rejoin_fresh.detail: Bob was admitted, accepted locally with secret/node key and pending join, then actually removed. Exhaustive acceptance/join query rows establish the universal cut/admission premises; a zero fresh-device admission count establishes newness. Carol rejoin emits an actual signed request from the same node key; passing Bob seed emits no request. After real Alice approval and Carol admission, a finite stored-op extension check proves permanent Bob removal while Carol and the shared node become live.
